description: Codigo de Edificacion de la Ciudad Autonoma de Buenos Aires (Ley 6.100, 2018, and its Reglamentos Tecnicos): minimum areas, sides, clear heights and illumination/ventilation ratios of dwelling rooms, matched by room name (accents ignored). Every rule citation names its article, a source_confidence (cited: number checked in the named source; to-verify: pending review by a CABA architect) and its source. Draft for professional review; not legal advice.
